title.zh: AI 应用工程与智能运维

description.zh: 面向 AI 应用工程、智能运维与平台方向岗位：AI 运维工作流、Skills 工程体系、GitOps 排障与支撑它们的执行平台。
description.en: For AI application engineering, intelligent operations and platform roles: AI operations workflows, skill engineering, GitOps diagnosis and the execution platforms behind them.

title.zh: 平台架构与云基础设施

description.zh: 面向架构师与技术负责人岗位：领域建模、框架抽象、核心实现与安全交付的技术细节。
description.en: For architect and technical lead roles: domain modeling, framework design, core implementation and secure delivery in technical detail.

title.zh: 云平台工程与技术管理

description.zh: 面向工程经理与技术管理岗位：技术方向、团队领导、跨团队复用、服务接管与工程规范。
description.en: For engineering management roles: technical direction, team leadership, cross-team reuse, service transitions and engineering standards.

title.zh: AI 方向深度项目经历

description.zh: 13–14 页的项目补充材料：每个项目的背景、设计理念与关键决策、核心实现、成果，以及与 AI 工作流的关联。
description.en: A 13–14 page project supplement: context, design decisions, core implementation, outcomes and AI workflow relevance for each project.
